Operator: Good afternoon, and welcome to the Northwind Widgets Fourth Quarter Earnings Conference Call. All lines are muted. A question-and-answer session will follow the prepared remarks.
Ada Byrne: Thank you. With me today are our chief executive and our finance chief. Some statements today are forward-looking and may differ from results.
Cal Dorn: Demand for widgets was steady this quarter, and we may see some uncertainty in the second half.
Gil Hart: Revenue rose from the same quarter a year ago. Gross margin was about flat.
Operator: Thank you. [Operator Instructions] Our first question comes from the line of Eli Fox.
Eli Fox: Could you say more about orders in the second half?
